mapper.insert: INSERT INTO point_history (member_id, type, amount, created_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{type}, #{amount}, NOW())
INSERT INTO donation (member_id, campaign_id, amount, donated_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{campaignId}, #{amount}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE campaign SET current_amount = current_amount + #{amount} WHERE campaign_id = #{campaignId}
mapper.select: SELECT campaign_id, title, status, goal_amount, current_amount FROM campaign WHERE campaign_id = #{campaignId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT history_id, member_id, type, amount, created_at FROM point_history WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
